children: CID Holdco, Inc. reported results for the second quarter of 2026 showing sharply lower revenue as the company shifted its business mix toward SaaS, with revenue of $12.4K and a net loss that narrowed to $3.77M; diluted loss per share was $(2.68). — 10-Q Summary
Revenue was $12.4K for Q2 2026, down from $126.8K in the year-ago quarter ( (90.2%) ).
Net income: Net loss of $3.77M for Q2 2026 vs. net loss of $28.86M in the year-ago quarter (improved YoY).
Diluted EPS was $(2.68) for Q2 2026 vs. $(50.05) in the year-ago quarter.
Revenue Trend: The company experienced a sharp YoY revenue decline as it shifted from hardware sales toward SaaS subscriptions, reducing near-term top-line activity.
Channel & GTM Shift: CID Holdco pivoted spending toward sales and marketing to drive adoption of its Dot Cloud offering while pausing large brand events and some marketing tools.
Operational Pause: The company implemented a temporary employee furlough and suspended manufacturing on May 25, 2026, retaining limited contractors to support customers.
R&D & Product Focus: Despite constrained capital, CID Holdco increased R&D investment to enhance Dot Cloud, AI and IoT capabilities and capitalized software development costs.
Liquidity Steps: Management raised incremental capital through equity purchase agreements and short-term financings to sustain operations and support recall plans.
